plan.title: SHG Loan Repayment & Purpose
plan.subtitle: Overview of loan status and usage across blocks

panels.title: Total amount repaid
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)"), 0) AS n FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Total loan amount
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)"), 0) AS n FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Repayment status distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loan purpose breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose" AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Repayment performance by block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)") AS repaid, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total, COALESCE(SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)"), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)"), 0) AS recovery_pct FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
The dashboard displays the total number of loans disbursed and the aggregate amounts involved. It highlights the recovery rate by comparing total repaid against total loaned.

The bar charts break down the portfolio by repayment status and loan purpose, showing where the majority of funds are directed and how many loans are currently overdue or regular.

The final table details performance at the block level, listing the top blocks by total loan volume and their specific recovery percentages.
